## Projects

### YouTube-RAG
A timestamp-aware RAG system for YouTube video transcripts. The documented pipeline includes transcript extraction and cleaning, timestamp-aware chunking, BGE embeddings, ChromaDB, BM25, hybrid retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion, cross-encoder reranking, grounded generation, and timestamp citation resolution.
Repository: https://github.com/Anirudh2627/YouTube-RAG
Reported test status: 129 passing tests in 24.49 seconds (user-reported, October 13, 2026).

### SpecMatch
Inference-focused work exploring speculative decoding and verification. Consult the repository for exact implementation and reproducible results.
Repository slug needs verification: https://github.com/Anirudh2627/SpecMatch

### Agent Arena
Agent-focused project. Consult repository for exact environment, design, baselines, and results.
Repository: https://github.com/Anirudh2627/Agent-arena

### Ledger
LLM-focused project. Consult repository README for exact scope and implemented evaluation methods.
Repository: https://github.com/Anirudh2627/Ledger

### TrustLens NLP
Fake-news classification using TF-IDF and model comparison, with a FastAPI backend and React frontend previously reported. A Linear SVC F1 score of 0.98202 was reported by the author; evaluation protocol should be checked before treating it as independently reproducible.
Repository: https://github.com/Anirudh2627/TrustLens-NLP

### Bastion
In progress. Planned direction is a security gateway for agent tool access, with explicit permissions, policy enforcement, approval flows, and audit logs. Do not represent these planned features as shipped.
Repository: add the dedicated project repository when available.

### Sentinel
Project scope and implementation details require verification against the current repository README.
